name: Receiving game under pressure
summary: Competitive game where one player only receives against varied serves and third shots; points count only on receive, and own unforced errors are tallied.
setup: Server varies the serve (deep, short, to the body) and plays any third shot, including speed-ups; serve as your rules allow, the serve rules are UNVERIFIED in this app
Receiver plays every rally live and competitively, from the return to the end
Game of 11 rallies, then swap roles
Tally rallies won on receive and the receiver's own unforced errors (an error on a ball the receiver had time and position to play safely)
success_criterion: In a game of 11 receiving rallies: win at least 6 and make at most 2 unforced errors
safety_notes: Live, competitive rallies with speed-ups and lobs: wear eye protection, turn and run back for a lob, never backpedal. Stop if dizzy or in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) Receiving against varied serves and attacks under score pressure trains winning receiving rallies (AN-02) while counting the cheap errors that pressure produces (AN-04). Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
